name: When Metrics Are Run
description: Ensures decisions rest on current evidence and that spending on measurement is approved and proportionate, by settling in advance when each metric runs.
purpose: Decide when each metric is run, in what stages, with what limit, who approves the spend, and when its result stops counting.
approach: Set for each metric its stages, a call budget, who approves the spend and what makes its result stale, and run it when what it would teach is worth its cost; a stale result informs and orders no run.
out_of_scope: How a metric is implemented; which alternative wins.
milestones: 1. Decisions backed by current results: every staleness case passes, so a stale or missing result is reported and a current one is not. [met: 2026-10-26]
measures_of_success: Decisions are backed by current results, spend is approved and proportionate, and stale results are found at the change rather than at a release. Standing conditions: Offline metrics run on every change; paid metrics run only when a decision depends on them, in staged samples; every recorded result can be told current from stale.
parameters: Trigger: every change for the offline metrics, in the test suite and in continuous integration; a paid metric only when a decision depends on it, in staged samples inside a call budget and with Joshua's approval.
inputs: The committed code, the case files and the results log.
outputs: A row per run in the results log with the commit and the hash of the cases; the strict check's verdict.
effects: Offline metrics call no paid service and no network; a paid metric calls a model only when it is run on a decision. Re-recording changes only the results log.
usage_notes: After committing measured code or cases, `esoi run --stale --plan` shows which results no longer describe the code; re-record with `esoi run --stale --for-decision` when a decision or release depends on them, then commit the results log. An arm that calls a model needs a cost estimate, a staged sample and Joshua's approval first.
